risk_note: RV2 (union/**, app.module.ts). Union module skeleton: UnionAdapter interface and registry, unified DTOs (string ids, integer fen, decimal-string commission rates parsed through @couli/money parseFen / pctStrToBp), endpoint config without secrets, governor (quota by purpose, breaker window and minimum requests; business rejections do not count toward the breaker). No real union API is called; real adapters are left as TODO interfaces blocked on promotion positions / siteId. Written by hand.
